question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 G 组：伊朗 vs 新西兰，90 分钟三路赛果？
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group G: IR Iran vs New Zealand, three-way 90-minute result?
one_liner_cn: 伊朗实力、经验与阵容稳定性全面占优，约六成胜率；新西兰高度依赖刚伤愈的 Chris Wood，爆冷空间有限但平局风险不可忽视。
one_liner_en: Iran are clearly superior in quality, experience and squad continuity (~60% win probability); New Zealand lean heavily on a just-recovered Chris Wood — upset room is limited, but the draw risk is real.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距 210 分（伊朗 1772 vs 新西兰 1562），Davidson 统计基线即给伊朗约 59% 胜率。
key_reasons.en: A 210-point Elo gap (Iran 1772 vs New Zealand 1562) puts the Davidson statistical baseline at ~59% for Iran.

key_reasons.cn: 新西兰头号射手 Chris Wood 整季受伤病困扰，4 月才复出，热身赛对英格兰 78 分钟已是 2024 年 11 月以来最多，状态存疑。
key_reasons.en: New Zealand's top scorer Chris Wood had an injury-disrupted season, only returning in April; 78 minutes vs England in the final warm-up was his most since November 2024.

key_reasons.cn: 伊朗 6 月 1 日最终名单核心齐整（Taremi 领衔、连续第三届世界杯），但 Azmoun 被排除，锋线深度略减。
key_reasons.en: Iran's June 1 final squad keeps a settled core (Taremi leading, third straight World Cup) but omits Azmoun, slightly trimming attacking depth.

method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, no host bonus — neutral venue) gives p_stat 59.5/22.8/17.8; bounded evidence adjustment (~5pp total, cap ±8pp, net +2.5pp Iran) yields p_final 62/22/16. 80% intervals reflect drawNu 0.6–0.8 sensitivity plus evidence thinness. No betting/odds/market data consulted.
